name: Verify lossless repack
command:
ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@raspberrypi.tailf63b31.ts.net 'cd ~ && /home/luigi/pulsar-rpi/v/bin/python -u q2_0_ref.py bonsai_b3.bin 785,6722,315,9625,374 3 > /tmp/oracle_b3.log 2>&1; echo "oracle(b3) EXIT=$?"; grep "^ARGMAX p4" /tmp/oracle_b3.log; grep "^ARGMAX p4" /tmp/oracle_test.log
/home/luigi/pulsar-rpi/v/bin/python - <<"EOF"
import re
def load(path):
    d, lay, pos = {}, None, None
    for line in open(path):
        m = re.match(r"^DX L(\d+) p(\d+)$", line.strip())
        if m: lay, pos = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)); continue
        m = re.match(r"^DX max=([-\d.eE+]+) v=\[([^\]]*)\]$", line.strip())
        if m and lay is not None:
            d.setdefault((lay, pos), (float(m.group(1)), [float(v) for v in m.group(2).split(",")]))
    return d
a, b = load("/tmp/oracle_test.log"), load("/tmp/oracle_b3.log")
keys = sorted(set(a) & set(b))
worst = (0.0, None)
for k in keys:
    (am, av), (bm, bv) = a[k], b[k]
    rel = abs(am - bm) / max(abs(am), 1e-30)
    if rel > worst[0]: worst = (rel, k)
    for x, y in zip(av, bv):
        r2 = abs(x - y) / max(abs(x), 1e-30)
        if r2 > worst[0]: worst = (r2, k)
print(f"compared {len(keys)} (layer,pos) pairs, Q2_0 vs base-3 repack")
print(f"worst relative difference: {worst[0]:.3e} at L{worst[1][0]} p{worst[1][1]}")
print("VERDICT:", "bit-identical" if worst[0] == 0.0 else "differs")
EOF'
description: Verify the base-3 repack is lossless: run the oracle on the repacked 1.7B blob and diff every DX signature against the Q2_0 run
